description: This file defines the main Application class for the Trading Journal Pro Android app. It initializes and manages the singleton instance of the app, lazily creates a Room database instance, and sets up application-wide dependencies.

classes.name: TradingJournalApp
classes.description: Main Application class that extends Android's Application, responsible for initializing application state and the database.
